title: Applecraft - The Volumes
description: A custom resource pack that changes the music discs in minecraft with songs and textures!
body:
**This is a personal project**. All rights to songs in this pack are credited and belong to the respective artists.

**Disclaimer:** 
Some songs in this pack contain explicit lyrics.

It is highly recommended you get this mod: https://modrinth.com/project/NtPNF0D7
The songs will cut off at certain points if you do not

If you would like to edit this and post it, you may as long as credit is attributed.

The pack is created for 1.21.7 (1.6 is 1.21.4), but will work with most modern versions.

## Updated pack mc meta for 1.20x and 1.21x coming soon to remove pack warning coming soon!
